description: HL main-line experience: structural lessons from v8->v9 phase-machine iterations. Each entry is a code-structure change (new decision module/phase), not a weight.

lessons.insight: Replace flat weighted scorer with 4-phase machine: GROW->SPLIT->HUNT_LOOP->SEAL. First real structural change; ratio 0.33->0.42, IG=1.87.
Rewrite GROW phase to space-maximising with survival fallback (flood-fill reachable space), soft enemy penalty, early split. Removes v8 hard rejects that trapped snakes.
lessons.structural_change: space-max GROW + survival fallback + soft enemy term
